description: This source file defines classes and functions for object detection using multiple models within the ImageAI library, including support for RetinaNet, YOLOv3, TinyYOLOv3, along with capabilities for image and video detection, object customization, and model loading.

classes.name: ObjectDetection
classes.description: Class for performing object detection on images using RetinaNet, YOLOv3, and TinyYOLOv3 models, with methods to load models, detect objects from images, and customize detection objects.

classes.name: VideoObjectDetection
classes.description: Class for performing object detection on videos or live streams, supporting multiple models and offering detailed detection event handling.
